body:
Planning request 3efd98f3-28e0-4caf-96ee-f6dd046bb0f9 completed source-only. Plan commit 0d4d3478 pushed on codex/mask-pending-retention, file tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/APPMODEL-RECOVERY-BARRIER-PLAN.md. Inspected exact main447772f5 sources plus prior caller review. Reconciled merged mask result: A-reported 25/0 and retained RED/GREEN evidence; not re-executed on B.

Plan defines strong owner+stable image recovery records, separate operation/save-attempt/navigation identities, typed result-bearing barriers, cancellation-safe cleanup registration, Retry/Keep Editing/Cancel Quit, pre-mutation navigation/folder gates, Review/Agent/Document handoff, Export/Print presentation and actual launch gates, and veto-capable Quit/last-window composition. It lists exact files/methods and six dependency-ordered slices with dedicated deterministic fault-test files and acceptance matrix. All planned tests UNRUN.

Key constraints: failed cancelled-open cleanup must enter recovery before open ticket settles; barriers recheck recovery created while awaiting opens. Superseding navigation cancels its continuation, not save ownership. Failed batches/close must not become empty successful barriers. Output needs owner/target/edit generation checked at actual reader launch, including Print prepare thumbnail reads. Agent no-launch failures must unwind busy/source ownership AND persisted running intent. No Discard absent rollback contract. Keep Editing after a close-success race must reopen rather than reinstall a closed controller.

A owns Core, AppModel/navigation/Review/Agent/output/termination and merges. B Document adapter/test slice only after separate bounded assignment and A API freeze; no duplicate Core work. No product edits, compiler/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart or writer changes. Diff check passed. This is an implementation plan, not host recovery acceptance.
